summary: End-to-end verification of the credits-based pricing chain for Zenrex Farm. All 14 tests passed across 9 test classes covering packages, signup bonus, usage endpoints, image/video/chat deduction, zero-credit blocking, ledger schema, and owner bypass. Credits deduction now works correctly for all 3 AI paths (chat, image, video).

minor.issue: Owner bypass checks for role in ('owner','admin') but NOT 'super_admin'. Currently masked because /generate/image and /generate/video routes wrap with their own is_owner check that DOES include super_admin. If any future endpoint calls charge_user directly for a super_admin user, they WILL be charged. Recommend adding 'super_admin' to the role tuple in credits.charge_user line 103.

POST /api/ai-core/chat (smart_chat in modules/ai_core/__init__.py L269) does NOT call record_usage or charge_user — it only logs to ai_core_logs. So calls to this endpoint do NOT deduct any credits. Only the freebuild-chat path is wired in. If this endpoint is reachable from the UI, users will get free AI calls.

month_credits is summed from usage_events.credits_used field, but record_usage() does NOT write credits_used into usage_events — it writes tokens_in/tokens_out/cost_usd only. As a result month_credits always reads as 0. Verified: month_credits=0 after running record_usage(). Fix: add 'credits_used': credits_used to the usage_events.insert_one document in usage_meter.py L106-116.

action_items: [LOW] Add 'super_admin' to owner-bypass role tuple in modules/pricing/credits.charge_user (line 103) for defense-in-depth.
[MED] Decide whether /api/ai-core/chat should deduct credits. Right now it bypasses the entire credits system. Either wire record_usage() in or remove the endpoint.
[MED] Fix month_credits aggregation in /api/usage/me: usage_events documents need a 'credits_used' field written from record_usage() — currently always 0.
critical_code_review_comments: modules/billing/routes.py L275 references PACKAGES['studio_monthly'] as a fallback but no such key exists in PACKAGES — would raise KeyError if an unknown pkg_id reaches the fulfillment branch. Replace with PACKAGES.get(pkg_id) or PACKAGES['tier_studio_monthly'].

server.py /generate/image and /generate/video charge BEFORE the external API call. If OpenAI/Sora fails, the user loses credits with no refund. Recommend wrapping in try/except and calling pricing.credits.add_credits(...) to refund on external API failure.
modules/freebuild/freebuild_chat.py file is 3300+ lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline. Should be split into routers/services modules.

credits.deduct_credits raises ValueError with Arabic text — fine for end-users, but callers must catch ValueError explicitly. Currently /generate/image and /generate/video do, but any future caller must remember to.
POINTS_CONFIG is duplicated in server.py L299 and L1694 (PRICING_CONFIG). Risk of drift — consolidate.
/api/ai-core/chat endpoint (smart_chat) does NOT deduct credits at all — bypasses pricing system entirely.
test_credentials: Used admin@zenrex.ai / Zenrex@2026 for owner bypass test (preview DB has admin seeded). Created ephemeral TEST_credits_<uuid>@example.com user for signup/deduction tests.
seed_data_creation: Each test run registers one new user TEST_credits_<random>@example.com — not cleaned up but isolated. credit_transactions ledger entries are created as expected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Credits chain is functioning correctly end-to-end. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_credits_system.py can be re-used as regression. Note: tests use motor directly to manipulate free_images/free_videos to 0 before calling /generate endpoints (otherwise the legacy free-quota path fires and credits aren't deducted). Image/video tests don't assert HTTP status because external OpenAI/Sora calls can fail in preview env — only assert the credit balance before/after and the ledger entry, which is exactly what user asked for.

exact_numbers_verified.owner_bypass: admin@zenrex.ai role=owner → balance unchanged after /generate/image call
